plan_name: Flower Delivery App MVP Execution Plan

tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with all tables (users, flowers, orders, order_items, cart, delivery_assignments)
Build Node.js/Express backend API with authentication, flower catalog endpoints, and cart management
Implement Stripe payment integration for checkout and order processing
Create React frontend with Home Screen, Flower Detail Screen, and Shopping Cart Screen following design specifications
Build Checkout Screen with delivery details, payment form, and order confirmation flow
Develop Order Tracking Screen with status timeline and delivery progress visualization
Implement User Profile Screen with order history, saved addresses, and payment methods management
Integrate SendGrid for email notifications on order status updates and confirmations
Build admin inventory management interface for flower catalog and order fulfillment
Implement responsive design and accessibility features (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, touch targets, screen reader support)
Add search functionality with category filtering and product detail navigation
Implement favorites/wishlist feature with heart icon toggle and saved items display

risks: Stripe payment integration complexity may delay checkout functionality and require additional testing for edge cases
Real-time order tracking and notification system dependencies on SendGrid may introduce latency or delivery failures
Mobile responsiveness across iOS and Android platforms requires extensive device testing to ensure consistent UX
Database performance with concurrent cart operations and inventory updates may require optimization for scale
Third-party API rate limits (Stripe, SendGrid) could impact user experience during high-traffic periods
